subsystems.name: Sample cache
subsystems.role: stores rock cores collected on Mars for later return.

subsystems.name: Sample Retrieval Lander
subsystems.role: lands near the cache and retrieves the tubes.

subsystems.name: Mars Ascent Vehicle
subsystems.role: launches the sample container from Mars into orbit.

subsystems.name: Earth Return Orbiter
subsystems.role: captures the container in Mars orbit and carries it back to Earth.

subsystems.name: Earth Entry System
subsystems.role: protects the samples during high-speed reentry and landing.

subsystems.name: Receiving facility
subsystems.role: containment laboratory where the samples are opened and analysed.

subsystems.name: Science instruments
subsystems.role: detect biosignatures and date the rocks with sensitivity impossible to fly.

buildSteps.title: Collect and cache samples
buildSteps.detail: A rover drills rock cores, seals each in a titanium tube, and leaves them at a depot on the Martian surface.

buildSteps.title: Land the retrieval lander
buildSteps.detail: A lander touches down with precision close to the depot, carrying a small rocket and a transfer system.

buildSteps.title: Transfer samples
buildSteps.detail: The rover or small helicopters bring the tubes to the lander, which loads them into the sample container.

buildSteps.title: Load the ascent vehicle
buildSteps.detail: The container is placed inside the Mars Ascent Vehicle, a small solid-fuel rocket.

buildSteps.title: Launch from Mars
buildSteps.detail: The ascent vehicle lifts off and injects the container into a low Mars orbit.

buildSteps.title: Capture in orbit
buildSteps.detail: An Earth Return Orbiter rendezvous with the container, captures it, and seals it inside a containment capsule.

buildSteps.title: Return to Earth
buildSteps.detail: The orbiter cruises back to Earth and releases the Earth Entry System on a trajectory to land.

buildSteps.title: Recover and contain
buildSteps.detail: The capsule is recovered, placed in a sealed transport container, and taken to a receiving facility.

buildSteps.title: Analyse under containment
buildSteps.detail: Tubes are opened in a high-containment lab and studied with instruments for biosignatures, chemistry and geochronology.

prerequisites.why: the lander must touch down close to the cached tubes to retrieve them.
small rockets have been tested on Earth, but none has yet launched from Mars.
demonstrated in Earth orbit, but not yet around another planet.
Apollo lunar samples were contained, but Mars samples require much stricter protocols.
the whole point is to use laboratory instruments too large to fly to Mars.

pathway.milestone: Perseverance rover caches rock cores in Jezero Crater
pathway.unlocks: a diverse set of samples from an ancient river delta.

pathway.milestone: Launch of the Sample Retrieval Lander and Earth Return Orbiter
pathway.unlocks: the hardware needed to retrieve and return the samples.

pathway.milestone: Mars Ascent Vehicle launch and orbital capture
pathway.unlocks: the sample container in Mars orbit, ready for the trip home.

pathway.milestone: Return to Earth and placement in a receiving facility
pathway.unlocks: samples available for analysis under containment.

pathway.milestone: Biosignature and geochronology results from Earth labs
pathway.unlocks: a definitive test of whether Mars ever hosted life, and a timeline of its history.
